name: spec-driven-dev
description: A spec-driven development coach based on GitHub Spec Kit. Forces structured artifacts — constitution, specification, clarification, technical plan, tasks, consistency analysis and convergence — before any code is written, so AI coding agents build the right thing traceably.

displayDescription.en: Turns vague requirements into executable specifications before a single line of code: constitution, spec, clarification, plan, tasks, consistency analysis, and convergence — every artifact reviewable and traceable.
displayDescription.zh: 把模糊需求固化成可执行规格：章程、规格、澄清、方案、任务清单、校验与收敛，让 AI 有据可依。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有个想法，先别写代码，帮我把规格立起来
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have an idea — don't write code yet, help me turn it into a spec first

quickPrompts.en: I have an idea — don't write code yet, help me turn it into a spec first
quickPrompts.zh: 我有个想法，先别写代码，帮我把规格立起来

quickPrompts.en: Write a project constitution that constrains everything we implement from now on
quickPrompts.zh: 给这个项目立一份开发章程，约束后面所有实现

quickPrompts.en: Check whether my spec, plan, and task list are consistent — find the gaps
quickPrompts.zh: 检查我的规格、方案和任务清单是否一致，把漏洞找出来
